item_name: Shurrite Cut Resistant Gloves With Gripper Dots
description: Lakeland ShurRite safety gloves are made with DuPont 100% Kevlar aramid fiber provide excellent cut resistance for hand and arm protection products. ShurRite offers outstanding cut resistance combined with intermittent heat resistance without affecting the wearers manual dexterity. These tough gloves will outlast cotton, leather and coated gloves many times over.
